description: Complete retained model fleet plus scientific batch profiles. GLM alone is excluded from this H100 deployment. Models must not disappear from acceptance when disabled or scaled to zero.

excluded_models.glm-5-2-fp8: User explicitly excluded GLM from H100. Its B300 work is outside this campaign.

variant_notes.openfold3: The earlier OpenFold3 service and openfold3-openbind batch backend are distinct runtime identities, not silently interchangeable implementations.
variant_notes.esmfold2-fast: Selectable ESMFold2 fast execution profile, counted separately as a public model ID, not a distinct model family.
variant_notes.rfdiffusion: The existing qualified scientific batch route fulfills this canonical model ID; a second permanent serving deployment is not required.

acceptance.snapshot: Qualify an optional fresh-process GPU restore wherever useful. Record unsupported or slower paths explicitly; image/weight/JIT caches do not count as GPU snapshots.
acceptance.scale_to_zero: Only after successful model verification; keep its route, artifacts and status discoverable.
